abilities.name: serene-grace
abilities.effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: rattled
abilities.effect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a dark, ghost, or bug move.

original-johto.flavorText: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.

hoenn.flavorText: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

updated-johto.flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

original-unova.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

updated-unova.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

kalos.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

updated-alola.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

swsh.flavorText: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.
